summary: iter23 — ElevenLabs TTS primary-path verification (Liam voice TX3LPaxmHKxFdv7VOQHJ) + floating-jarvis sidebar wire-up regression. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_elevenlabs_tts.py with 7 tests across 4 classes. Result: 7/7 pass (100%). Confirmed: (1) POST /api/assistant/tts/stream returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type: audio/mpeg AND real MP3 bytes (ID3 header + MPEG frame sync) — backend log emits '[TTS] ElevenLabs streaming (4096B first chunk)' immediately after the call, NEVER '[TTS] Using OpenAI shimmer fallback'. (2) GET /api/assistant/tts/stream?text=... — same result, works from expo-audio player. (3) GET /api/assistant/history returns [] for unauth (by design, uses optional_current_user), returns a JSON list of {id, role, content, created_at} messages for kishan (200 OK, list-shape, existing history preserved). (4) POST /api/assistant/chat with session_id + message + honorific returns 200 SSE with a Hinglish reply. (5) POST /api/auth/login for kishan/Kishan@Boss2026 → access_token OK. (6) FRONTEND: floating-jarvis sidebar wire-up verified end-to-end on the deployed EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — quick-login → dashboard, [data-testid=floating-jarvis] tappable, sidebar opens with existing message history rendered (multi-turn Hinglish conversation shows correctly with the 'BRAIN SYNCED' badge), jarvis-input + jarvis-send work, sending 'Boss, ek line mein hello bolo.' returned 'Namaste Kishan Sir, sab set hai — bolo kya kaam hai! 😊', and the 2 additional log entries at 14:57:15 & 14:57:17 confirm ElevenLabs TTS was triggered by the UI action. NO React Native red screens on the dashboard/sidebar. HOWEVER — found a NEW critical UI bug on /sign-in.tsx: three call sites (line 109 `onPress={onSubmit}`, line 161 `onSubmitEditing={onSubmit}`, line 177 `onPress={onSubmit}`) pass the GestureResponderEvent as the first arg to `onSubmit(overrideUsername?, overridePassword?)` — the very first line does `(overrideUsername ?? username).trim()`, which throws 'trim is not a function' when overrideUsername is the event object. Red-screen reproduced when clicking the top 'LOGIN' icon-button. The 'LOG IN & OPEN DASHBOARD' primary button (line 177) has the same bug. Only the 'Quick login as Kishan Sir (demo)' button (line 207) works because it passes real strings. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch present — clean.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: `useNativeDriver` is not supported on web because the native animated module is missing. Falls back to JS-driven animation. On web preview this is harmless but on native builds it means every animation using useNativeDriver:true will silently run on the JS thread. Reference: /app/frontend/app/sign-in.tsx pulse animation + likely floating-jarvis pulse. Consider gating useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web'.

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — React Native Web 0.19+ deprecates shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius for web. Not a blocker but will start throwing in RN Web 0.20. Reference: any styles.card / GlassCard shadow definitions.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — deprecated in RN 0.75+. Move any pointerEvents="none" prop into style={{pointerEvents: 'none'}}.

action_items: URGENT: /app/frontend/app/sign-in.tsx — wrap onSubmit call sites so they don't leak the event as the username: change `onPress={onSubmit}` (lines 109, 177) to `onPress={() => onSubmit()}` and `onSubmitEditing={onSubmit}` (line 161) to `onSubmitEditing={() => onSubmit()}`. Alternatively, add a type-guard `if (typeof overrideUsername !== 'string') overrideUsername = undefined;` at the top of onSubmit. This blocks first-time real users (only the quick-login demo path works today).
Optional (deprecation): migrate shadow* → boxShadow and prop pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents before RN Web 0.20 ships.
Optional (perf): gate useNativeDriver=true behind Platform.OS !== 'web' in sign-in.tsx and floating-jarvis.tsx animations to silence the JS-fallback warning on web preview.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1912-1946 _stream_tts_with_fallback — the ElevenLabs branch swallows only HTTPException from _stream_elevenlabs_tts; a network-level httpx exception (e.g. httpx.ReadTimeout during the aiter_bytes) would propagate out of the StreamingResponse mid-stream and the client gets a truncated MP3 with no fallback. rca_of_issue: sign-in.tsx red-screen RCA: React Native's Pressable/TextInput pass a synthetic event as the FIRST argument to onPress/onSubmitEditing. The developer wrote `onSubmit = useCallback(async (overrideUsername?: string, overridePassword?: string) => { const u = (overrideUsername ?? username).trim(); ... })` intending overrides for the demo quick-login. When wired directly as `onPress={onSubmit}`, RN passes GestureResponderEvent → overrideUsername is truthy (an object) → .trim() throws. Reproduction: open /sign-in, tap the top 'LOGIN' icon-button OR the main 'LOG IN & OPEN DASHBOARD' button → red-screen 'overrideUsername ?? username.trim is not a function'. Mitigation: wrap in arrow (`onPress={() => onSubmit()}`) at lines 109, 161, 177 in /app/frontend/app/sign-in.tsx.
